Metadata.title: Hide Kindle Orders
Metadata.description: A Firefox extension that hides Kindle orders on the Amazon.co.jp order history page.

Hero.description: A Firefox extension that hides Kindle orders on your Amazon.co.jp order history, one click at a time.
Hero.title:
Keep Kindle orders
out of your history.

toggle.title: One click
toggle.body: Flip the toolbar button to hide or show. There is no settings screen.

scope.title: Order history only
scope.body: It only touches the Amazon.co.jp order history page. Nothing else.

quiet.title: Nothing sent
quiet.body: The hiding happens inside your browser. Nothing leaves it.
